subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction drop aborted assistant tool-call turns before summarization, matching the prompt-send sanitizer, or should OpenClaw preserve them by synthesizing an interrupted tool result?
rationale: Both policies avoid strict-provider orphaned-tool-use rejection, but they encode different session-state semantics: dropping loses the interrupted attempt, while synthesis preserves a fabricated failure result that may affect model reasoning.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge this PR’s approach so compaction removes aborted tool-call turns before provider summarization, consistent with the existing prompt-send sanitizer behavior.

options.title: Require synthetic interrupted result
options.body: Ask the contributor to preserve the interrupted assistant turn by adding a synthetic tool result and focused tests for that policy instead of dropping it.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers design a richer interrupted-tool recovery contract shared by compaction, replay, and provider adapters.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR’s approach so compaction removes aborted tool-call turns before provider summarization, consistent with the existing prompt-send sanitizer behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the transcript repair/session-state contract, and `steipete` has the strongest feature-history signal for both compaction and transcript repair files.
